summary: Iteration 3 — Google OAuth race fix + Streaming search feature tested end-to-end. Backend: 54/54 pytest (100%) including 12 new phase-3 tests (Google auth negative + /api/streaming/episodes with 5 providers + empty-name + auth-required). Frontend: AuthCallback with #session_id=BAD_TOKEN correctly shows 'Falha no login com Google' / 'Invalid Google session' / 'Voltar ao login' link — proves AuthProvider skip-when-hash fix works (no silent redirect to /login). Both /login and /register have google-login-button with text 'Continuar com Google'. Search page streaming mode verified: clicking search-quick-netflix fills input with 'Netflix' and renders streaming-search-results with 3 episode cards for admin library; typing 'breaking' shows regular series results (Breaking Bad visible); typing 'Netflix' directly also activates streaming mode. All phase-1 and phase-2 regression tests pass. No critical bugs.

minor.issue: Broad `except Exception` still catches real network errors and returns 502 for bogus sessions; in this run it consistently returns 401 'Invalid Google session' as expected — spec requirement met. Carried-over code-quality note from iteration 2.

ui_bugs.component: Search.jsx quick-chip testid for providers containing '+'
ui_bugs.issue: Spec requires testids 'search-quick-disney+', 'search-quick-apple-tv+', 'search-quick-paramount+' but Search.jsx line 110 uses `p.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')` which converts '+' to a trailing '-'. Actual testids rendered: 'search-quick-disney-', 'search-quick-apple-tv-', 'search-quick-paramount-'. Buttons themselves work (click them and streaming mode activates) — only the testid string differs from the spec.

action_items: Search.jsx line 110 — change the testid generation so '+' becomes literal '+'. Suggest: `data-testid={`search-quick-${p.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,'-')}`}` so 'Disney+' → 'search-quick-disney+', 'Apple TV+' → 'search-quick-apple-tv+', 'Paramount+' → 'search-quick-paramount+', 'Prime Video' → 'search-quick-prime-video'. (Alternatively update the spec to the current '-' form — but the review_request explicitly listed testids with '+'.)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still 1032 lines — split into routers (carried from iter 1 & 2).
/api/auth/google's broad `except Exception` → 502 still masks real errors. Narrow to httpx.HTTPError + ValueError and log traceback.

/api/streaming/episodes fires parallel TMDB /tv/{id} calls for EVERY library item on every request. For a user with 20+ series this is 20 TMDB round-trips per streaming search — add a short in-memory cache (5–15 min) keyed by tmdb_id.
Duplicated matching logic: Search.jsx streaming-detection + providers.js PROVIDER_BRANDS + server.py substring match — consider consolidating under a shared util.
Good: endpoint correctly returns 401 on missing auth, 422 on missing `name` query param, and empty response on blank `name`.

Good: episodes are correctly sorted desc by air_date; payload includes all fields required by the spec (tmdb_id, series_name, season_number, episode_number, air_date, kind, providers, matched_providers).

rca of the issue: Issue: quick-chip testids for providers with '+' in the name do not match the spec. Root cause: Search.jsx line 110 uses regex `replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')` which strips '+'. Reproduction: open /search, inspect DOM, observe 'search-quick-disney-' instead of 'search-quick-disney+'. Mitigation: change the regex to `replace(/\s+/g, '-')` (whitespace-only) so special chars like '+' are preserved, OR accept trailing-dash form and update the spec.
